text: The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) is a mutex in CPython that allows only one thread to execute Python bytecode at a time. CPU-bound multithreaded Python programs do not achieve parallelism because of the GIL, while I/O-bound programs benefit because the lock is released during blocking operations.

FastAPI uses Pydantic models to validate request bodies automatically. When validation fails, FastAPI responds with HTTP status 422 and a JSON detail array describing each invalid field. Pydantic type annotations also power the auto-generated OpenAPI documentation served at /docs.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds an LLM's answer in external knowledge: the system first retrieves relevant documents, then injects them into the prompt as context before generation. RAG reduces hallucination on private or recent facts the model was never trained on.

Cosine similarity measures the angle between two embedding vectors and ranges from -1 to 1, with 1 meaning identical direction. Sentence embeddings from models like all-MiniLM-L6-v2 place semantically similar texts close together, so cosine similarity works as a semantic search ranking function.

HTTP status 409 Conflict indicates the request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource, such as a duplicate creation or a stale update. It differs from 422, which signals that the payload itself failed validation.
Sourdough starter is a fermented mix of flour and water containing wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria. A healthy starter doubles in volume within 4 to 8 hours of feeding and smells pleasantly sour.
